description: Stage2 — 3s 滑动窗口特征提取 (单通道 PPG + EMG + ACC) + XGBoost

preprocessing.ppg: remove_burr → remove_step → medfilt(50ms) → movavg(30ms) → BP(0.4-6Hz, order=4)
preprocessing.emg: highpass(20Hz, order=2) → bandstop(49.8-50.2,149.8-150.2) → notch(50/100/200/300/400Hz,Q=100) → abs(envelope); leak_ref is captured before bandstop/notch

EMG_consensus_PKF_range.formula: max([EMG0_PKF, EMG1_PKF] (peak frequency in 20-450Hz band)) - min([EMG0_PKF, EMG1_PKF] (peak frequency in 20-450Hz band))
